title: Keto Grilled Chicken Skewers
description: Tender and flavorful chicken skewers made with a blend of spices and grilled to perfection. This keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Vibrant spices (paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper)

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, vibrant spices, lime juice, and a pinch of salt.
3. Add chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
4. Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through.
6. Garnish with crisp chopped cilantro and serve hot.
7. If using American cheese, sprinkle on top of skewers during the last minute of grilling.
